hints.title: Extract and Sort
hints.text: Extract the subarray from index l[i] to r[i] and sort its elements.

hints.title: Check Common Difference
hints.text: Compute the difference between the first two elements and verify every adjacent pair matches it.

hints.title: Record Boolean Result
hints.text: If any pair difference fails to match the common difference, record false; otherwise true.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Permuting elements exhaustively takes factorial time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting each sliced subarray takes O(k log k) time and O(k) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle subarrays of length 2 naturally and ensure difference check is uniform.
